newsitem.title: UK: Capita set for UK civil service agency sale.
newsitem.headline: Capita set for UK civil service agency sale.

text.p: The UK government has picked Capita Group Plc as its preferred bidder to acquire the Recruitment and Assessment Services Agency (RAS) which hires civil servants and provides consultancy work, the company said.
In a statement, Capita said it was now entering final negotiations with the government and a further announcement would be made in due course.
RAS recruits for all grades of the civil service and provides consultancy, including assessments and development centres.
Capita said it had the "proven skills in the areas of recruitment, training and associated consultancy."
